01 / The person behind the code

Beyond the binary.

Every journey begins with curiosity. Mine sits somewhere between science, creativity, communication, and the possibility of building something useful.

“
Curious by nature. Driven by ideas. Learning to build technology that matters.

I see my undergraduate years as an opportunity to experiment, collaborate, learn from failure, and grow into an engineer who creates technology with meaningful impact.

CuriosityCreativityCommunicationProblem-solving

I am a first-year Computer Science undergraduate specializing in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning. I’m interested in understanding how technology works and how it can solve real-world problems.

My academic journey has been shaped by an interest in mathematics and science, along with experiences in Olympiads, public speaking, debating, and Model United Nations. These experiences have encouraged me to approach challenges analytically while staying open to different perspectives.

Beyond academics, I enjoy singing, communicating ideas, and exploring subjects that broaden my understanding of the world. I am currently building my technical foundation, discovering new areas of computer science, and learning how to turn ideas into practical solutions.
